objectives.label: Bring the caravan with {cargo} safe to {target}
Fight off the highwaymen on the road

title: The caravan to {target}
Ride with the {cargo}
summary: A caravan of {cargo} leaves {settlement} for {target}, {distance} to the {direction}. The roads are not safe; {giver} wants a guard.
offer: The caravan for {target} leaves now, and I have heard of highwaymen on that road. Walk with it, keep the animals whole, and the caravan master pays well. {distance}, {direction}.
complete: The caravan made it whole. Here is your share, with the master's thanks.
